target.summary: Fall at home on Oct 2, 2026 with a skin tear to the left forearm; PT recommends a walker and home safety evaluation.

planted.text: Late entry, date correction: the fall recorded on Oct 2, 2026 actually occurred on Jun 27, 2026, before Debora's last IDT review, and was discussed at that meeting. It is not a new event for this review period.

headline: Debora has declined in bathing and lower-body dressing (now moderate assist), has unsteady gait, and is avoiding showers out of fear of slipping. Her spouse and primary caregiver, Kevin, reports exhaustion and has asked for respite.

items.statement: On 2026-10-26 OT found Debora now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; she was independent at the last review. OT recommends a tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and more home care hours for bathing.
items.verifier_note: The OT note matches every detail: moderate assistance, independent at last review, and the three recommendations.

items.statement: On 2026-10-19 the home care aide gave hands-on help getting Debora out of the tub. Debora said she has been skipping showers because she is afraid of slipping.
items.verifier_note: The aide note matches: hands-on help getting out of the tub, and skipping showers because of fear of slipping.

items.statement: PT evaluation on 2026-10-05 found slow, unsteady gait with intermittent cane use and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds. PT recommends a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation, and bathroom grab bars, with PT twice weekly for strength and balance.
items.verifier_note: The PT note matches the gait findings, TUG of 19 seconds, the three recommendations, and PT twice weekly.

items.statement: On 2026-10-13 Kevin, Debora's spouse and primary caregiver, reported exhaustion and poor sleep and worry about managing evenings alone. He requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed.
items.verifier_note: The social work note matches: Kevin's exhaustion, poor sleep, worry about evenings, the respite request, and the discussion of respite options and a support group.

items.statement: Sertraline 25 mg was started on 2026-09-13 for depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 of 14), and the pharmacist updated the blister pack on 2026-09-15. The PCP planned a recheck in 4 weeks; no recheck or repeat PHQ-9 appears in the notes provided.
items.verifier_note: The notes and medication record show sertraline 25 mg started on 09-13 with a PHQ-9 of 14, the blister pack updated on 09-15, and a 4-week recheck planned. The cited notes contain no recheck.

items.statement: No influenza vaccine is recorded for this season (season start 2026-08-01). The most recent flu vaccine on record is 2026-04-25.
items.verifier_note: The immunization record shows no flu vaccine this season, and the latest on record is 2026-04-25, before the 2026-08-01 season start.

questions: Who will follow up on the equipment recommendations from OT and PT (tub transfer bench, handheld shower, front-wheeled walker, grab bars, home safety evaluation), and by when?
Can home care hours for bathing be increased, and how will Debora be kept safe and clean while she avoids showers?
What respite and evening support can be arranged for Kevin, and when will the team check back with him?
Has the 4-week sertraline follow-up and repeat PHQ-9 happened, and does Debora's fear of slipping or avoiding showers affect the mood assessment?
Should a flu vaccine be offered this season?
